# TimeSpanUnits

`Flare.Components.TimeSpanUnits`

Which segments a FlareTimeSpanPicker shows. Flags rather than a "smallest unit" enum: a field can legitimately show days and minutes and skip hours, and an ordered scale cannot say that.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | No segments - an empty field, which is never what a caller means. |
| `Days` | `1` | Whole days. |
| `Hours` | `2` | Hours. |
| `Minutes` | `4` | Minutes. |
| `HoursMinutes` | `6` | Hours and minutes - the working-time shape. |
| `Seconds` | `8` | Seconds. |
| `All` | `15` | Every segment. |

## Used by components

- `FlareTimeSpanPicker`
